steps.title: What "tilt" looks like
steps.text:
**Tilt** is when emotions have taken over your trading. You trade faster and bigger, and you start breaking your own rules.

Typical signs: chasing losses, taking trades outside your plan, ignoring stops, and feeling that you **must** win money back right now.

When you notice tilt, the best trade is **no trade**. Stop for the day.

steps.question: Which of these is a sign you might be on tilt?
options: Increasing your position size to win back a loss quickly
Taking a break after reaching your daily loss limit
Skipping a trade that doesn't match your plan
Reviewing your journal at the end of the day
steps.explanation: Sizing up to recover losses is classic tilt. The other three are signs of discipline.

steps.title: Your body is part of your trading
steps.text:
Tired, stressed, hungry, unwell or upset? Your decisions suffer, and it's hard to notice from the inside.

Many experienced traders simply **don't trade** when they've slept badly or are dealing with something big in their life. No trade is worth your health or your relationships.

steps.title: When trading stops being healthy
steps.text:
Trading with real money can become harmful, in a similar way to gambling. Warning signs include:

• Trading with money you **can't afford to lose**: rent, bills, savings you need, or borrowed money.

• **Hiding** your trading or losses from people close to you.

• Feeling **unable to stop**, or restless and irritable when you're not trading.

• **Chasing losses** again and again.

• Losing sleep over it.

steps.question: A friend is trading with money set aside for rent, hoping to "turn it around". What's the best advice?
options: Stop trading with money they need, and talk to someone they trust or a support service
Trade bigger so they can recover faster
Switch to a more volatile market
Keep going: the losses will come back
steps.explanation: Money needed for essentials should never be at risk. Talking to someone early makes a real difference.

steps.title: Where to get help
steps.text:
If any of this sounds familiar, you're not alone, and support is free and confidential.

**UK**: National Gambling Helpline (GamCare), **0808 8020 133**, 24/7.

**US**: National Problem Gambling Helpline, **1-800-MY-RESET** (1-800-697-3738), call, text or chat.

**Elsewhere in Europe**: your national gambling-support helpline, or your doctor.

If you ever feel in crisis, contact your local emergency services.

steps.title: Practise safely here
steps.text:
Everything you trade in this app uses **virtual money**, so you can build skills without that risk.

Take breaks whenever you want. Your progress will be here when you come back.

points: **Tilt** = emotions in charge. Stop for the day when you notice it.
Don't trade when you're tired, stressed or upset.
Know the **warning signs** of harmful trading.
Free, confidential help exists. Reaching out early matters.
